verification.comment: You asked for the order number or postcode but did not confirm the caller's full name plus one of those before looking up and sharing order details; the agent should confirm both.

process_compliance.quote: I'm putting so you on holds now.
process_compliance.comment: You placed the caller on hold without asking permission first, which the policy requires, though you did thank them on return only partially; ask permission before holding next time.

closing.comment: The call ended without you confirming next steps or asking if there was anything else, so close by confirming what happens next and asking if they need anything more.
